notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

Today we're happy to release a new version of the game, 1.4 with some new items and vehicles, such as the excavator:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/3f076c95cbe9b2bc2b63f67ac66738fd1dc04a28.gif[/img]

This update also fixes a lot of bugs and improve the way you can place blocks.

The full game, Technicity is also available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781180/Technicity/

notes.title: 🚀 Full version is now available! 🚀
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

After more than three years of hard work, Technicity is finally available! You can get your copy of the game right now with a 20% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781180/Technicity/

Here are some of the new features compared to the Prologue:
- Improved UI
- Improved co-op mode
- Create a shop and you'll be able to change your player skin using a fitting room
- Share your world to the Steam Workshop and see what other player’s city looks like!
- Various new goals and new types of building
- Interactions with citizens, they can give you a job
- Excavator: Use this new vehicle to quickly demolish large structures
- Build on different biomes of the huge 384 km² map
- Get access to police helicopters, firetrucks, planes and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/289d06a8141f642928a000a0be78d5ee68cc3993.jpg[/img]

I would like to thank every one of you who played the early demos, sent some great ideas and feedback and helped make this game come alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/7b81f4cf4bc7f09ba63a5c8f496b8115cf33f97c.gif[/img]

Now let's all push together to make the release as successful as possible: the bigger the community becomes, the better it will be for the game!

[url=https://discord.gg/gTbphhEjNx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🚀 Prologue Has Been Released! 🚀
notes.content:
Hi Builders,

Finally, [b]Technicity: Prologue[/b] is available for you to enjoy, and it's free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/d0933713c4d2c1f299ddb51fe424cb632e3a6dfd.jpg[/img]

This is a prologue for [b]Technicity[/b], so that you can have a first experience of what you'll be able to create in this game.

The Prologue includes:
- first-person city-building mechanics with powerful tools that allow you to build faster and bigger
- online co-op mode: invite your Steam friends to your world
- Steam Workshop support: share your building prefabs and custom items, see what the community has created
- tasks and job: inhabitants come to your city and you can interact with them with jobs in various places like taxi station and warehouse

You can also add the full game to wishlist now to make sure you are notified when it's released:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781180/Technicity/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/49cc81fe84be3208eb8de712405c6eabce2d64d7.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for your support and if you didn't already join our Discord, feel free to come in and share your ideas and suggestions for the game!

[url=https://discord.gg/gTbphhEjNx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev log #2: Co-Op mode, and more
notes.content:
Hi Builders!

Here are some news about some of the mechanics we're currently working on.

The Co-Op mode is now completed and will be included in the free Technicity: Prologue! Invite your friends to join your world and build new cities or have fun with some role play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/52f92ea301334effd4e3af6bd322ba2eef73bde5.gif[/img]


Steam Workshop is also coming in the free Prologue:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/3e9ab8e20e1cf2b2bd6aef3cf62babd48a847d42.jpg[/img]

You will be able to share your buildings and custom blocks or discover other creations made by the community, including  custom items which can have a useful function and make your world even more interesting.


You can now place several rows of blocks at a time, up to 32 blocks in total:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/cf3ccc7284d8ed1d902d15c33b6af60ae6f32f4e.gif[/img]

Slabs and thin slabs have now two possible positions when you place them, use SHIFT to choose position.
Columns and wood blocks have now two possible angles when you place them, use SHIFT to tilt the block:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/86851ccaefc85b3f2eeef2cd588be6f3ba93babd.jpg[/img]


A new building type will be available in prologue: Taxi Station. It will make it possible to fast travel to any location if you have built a Taxi Station in your world, simply open the Map and choose your destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/4afa8b9f7c1c78e35ada5461940db70bd4eb0007.jpg[/img]

In other news:
- Cement mixer ui was improved
- You can now use new parts types to design custom items: 
  -> Editable Sign (Shows a text which can be edited by the owner), 
  -> SoundBox (Parts which emits a sound), 
  -> Containers (Parts with an inventory)
- A lot of bugs where fixed!

Tell us what you think about this update on our Discord channel. Feel free to share your ideas and suggestions!

[url=https://discord.gg/gTbphhEjNx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179608/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]
